title: Spectacular Experience
text: The experience with this type of cavas with terpenes left me surprised. Not only did I discover unique nuances and aromas with each type of cava, but I also learned a lot about the brewing process and they cleared up all my doubts. The Mood was very welcoming, we were treated very well with closeness and professionalism from the team, which made everything enjoyable and enriching. Without a doubt, I recommend this experience for those who enjoy good cava and want to try something different like cava that you see everywhere and also want to live a very special and memorable moment.
author: Serratoso

title: Recomendable 100%
text:
We loved the tasting both my partner and I. We were about 10 people enjoying the tasting and that created a very close and pleasant Mood. 
The combination of cava with food was amazing. 

I already have new favorite cava since that day!

title: A surprising and truly fun Cava tasting!
text:
The pairing of sparkling wines with cheeses and terpenes was a real journey of flavors and aromas. I had never tried such unique sparkling wines before.
The place is beautiful and intimate, with a private space just for our group, which made it easy to end up chatting with everyone. On top of that, the host was delightful and made the whole experience lively and enjoyable.
Highly recommended!
author: 567nicole347
